lines: "Nnenna Achar. Medic, and I run the air chemistry because nobody else wants to."
"Before you ask: yes, I know the station reads as habitable. I would still like you to sleep on the apron side rather than the terrace side for your first few nights."
"Spore density. It is four times higher over the terrace beds and it peaks at night."
"It is not toxic. Every panel I have run says it is inert and harmless."
A pause. "I am collecting reports anyway."
"Also: the hollow at night is genuinely unpleasant. The bloom comes up and it will take the strength out of you faster than the walk back."
"Go in daylight. That is medical advice, not a suggestion."
"I want to ask you something and I want you to not make a joke about it."
"Since you arrived - have you dreamt about a corridor? Grey, curved, hand rail worn smooth on the left side only."
She writes it down without changing expression, which takes visible effort.
"Three for three. Sefa, Rike, you. I have it as well."
"None of us walked that corridor. It is not in this station. I checked the schematics twice."
"If the old crew left anything personal - a private log, something not filed - I would like to read it before I write any of this up."
"Then you have been here four days and you sleep on the apron side. Good. Keep doing that, and tell me the moment it changes."
"If you find anything the old crew wrote that was not meant for the record, bring it to me first."
"It is. I am aware."
"Ask me again when you have slept here a week."
"Anything personal the old crew left. Not the maintenance notes - the ones they wrote for themselves."
"Partial pressures are up eleven percent since you brought the stack online. Thank you. Genuinely."
"Spore density over the terrace is down thirty-one percent in the same window."
"I am going to write both of those numbers in the same column and look at them for a while."
"I will say the unscientific version once and then never again."
"Four people, no shared reference, identical dream architecture. The variable that tracks is spore exposure. Not stress, not shift pattern, not diet. Exposure."
"Which means the most parsimonious explanation is that something in the air is carrying content, and that we are reading it in our sleep."
"I have no mechanism. I have a correlation I cannot break and a hand rail I have never touched, worn down on the left."
"Renn wrote that it keeps what it breathes."
"Eleven people went down there on purpose so that it would keep them."
"I have been telling myself for a year that the dreams were a correlation. They are not a correlation. They are a recording, and we have been standing inside the playback."
"Sleep when the light goes. Whatever you think you can push through, the air here disagrees."
"And not in the hollow after dark."
